tldr: Lilith in Libra: the wound around being wanted; fear of being alone drives the partnership.
body: With Lilith in Libra, shame lives in the mirror: feeling unattractive, unadmired, unchosen. The fear of going through life alone powers charm and seduction as strategy, and partnerships entered for the attention, status, or security they bring.
gift: Grace, charm, and real gifts for partnership once being alone stops being the enemy.
challenge: Neediness for admiration, relationships treated as transactions, self-worth outsourced to whoever is looking.
note: Distilled from the Black Moon Lilith compilation (Resources/937057437-Lillith-Black-Moon.docx), 'Black Moon Lilith in the Signs' long-form chapter. Lilith reads as a wound-point: shame and rejection processed through the sign's style. Owner-reviewed for live use, 2026-07-28.
